days.lo: I am learning to analyze to find two objects that are exactly the same or not exactly the same.
sc: I can find two objects that are exactly the same and explain why they are the same.
I can find two objects that are not exactly the same and explain how they are different.

days.lo: I am learning to analyze to find two similar objects- these are the same but.
sc: I can find two objects that are similar.
I can analyze two objects and determine how they are the same and different.
I can use the sentence stem: “These are the same, but this one is ___, and this one is ___.” to explain my thinking.

days.lo: I am learning to classify to find two objects that share a visual pattern, color, and use.
sc: I can find two objects that share the same pattern.
I can find two objects that share the same color.
I can find two objects and explain how they are used together using the sentence frame: “I use a ___ and ___for___.”

days.lo: I am learning to classify items into two pre-determined categories.
sc: I can sort objects into the correct category.
I can explain why I placed an object into a category.

days.lo: I am learning to classify items into three categories, determine the count in each, and reason about how the last number named determines the total.
sc: I can choose a picture and place it into the correct category.
I can count the number of pictures in a category.
I can explain that the last number said when counting, names the total in a category.

days.lo: I am learning to sort categories by count and identify categories with 2, 3, and 4 within a given scenario.
sc: I can choose a set of objects and count them.
I can sort the set into the correct category based on the count.
I can count and color a set of pictures based on 2, 3, or 4.

days.lo: I am learning to sort by count in vertical columns and horizontal rows (linear configurations to 5) and match to numerals on cards.
sc: I can find objects in the classroom to match a given numeral card up to 5.
I can sort a set of cubes and match a numeral to it.
I can count out pictures and match it to a number.
I can count out a set of cubes horizontally and/ or vertically.

days.lo: I am learning to answer how many questions to 5 in linear configurations (5-group), with 4 in an array configuration and compare ways to count five fingers.
sc: I can count objects that are in a row.
I can count objects that are in an array.
I can count pictures and circle the correct number.

days.lo: I am learning to, within linear and array dot configurations of numbers 3, 4, and 5, find hidden partners.
sc: I can find hidden partners in a linking cube tower of 5.
I can find hidden partners for the number 3 using dots that are in a row.
I can find hidden partners for the number 3 using dots that are in an array. (These SCs can be recreated using number 4 and 5.)

days.lo: I am learning to, within circular and scattered dot configurations of numbers 3, 4, and 5, find hidden partners.
sc: I can find hidden partners in a group of bear counters.
I can find hidden partners for the number 3 using dots arranged in a circle.
I can find hidden partners for the number 3 using dots that are scattered. (These SCs can be recreated using number 4 and 5.)

days.lo: I am learning to model decompositions of 3 with materials, drawings, and expressions.
sc: I can decompose 3 using counting bears.
I can decompose 3 using linking cubes.
I can decompose 3 by drawing a picture.
I can write an expression to represent my decomposition.

days.lo: I am learning to understand the meaning of zero.
sc: I can count back to zero starting at 5 using linking cubes.
I can count a set of pictures and tell how many.
I can write the number 0.
I understand the math word for none is zero.

days.lo: I am learning to order and write numerals 0-3 to answer how many questions.
sc: I can write and order numbers 0-3.
I can count a set of pictures and tell how many.
I can decompose 3 using linking cubes.
I can decompose 3 by drawing a picture.
I can write a number sentence to represent my decomposition.

days.lo: I am learning to write numerals 1-3 and represent decompositions with materials, drawings, and equations.
sc: I can decompose 3 using linking cubes.
I can decompose 3 by drawing a picture.
I can write a number sentence to represent my decomposition.
I can color a picture to match a number sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to write numerals 1-5 in order and answer and make drawings of decompositions with totals of 4 and 5 without equations.
sc: I can put number cards in order using numbers up to 5.
I can decompose 4 in different ways using linking cubes.
I can decompose 5 in different ways using linking cubes.
I can draw more pictures needed to make 4.
I can draw more pictures needed to make 5.
I can write numbers 4 and 5.

days.lo: I am learning to count 4-6 objects in vertical and horizontal linear configurations and array configurations.
sc: I can count a given number of linking cubes that are lined up in columns and rows.
I can find a number card to match the number of objects counted.
I can draw one more picture in a set, count them, and write the number I counted.
I can draw pictures based on a given number.

days.lo: I am learning to count 4-6 objects in circular and scattered configurations and count 6 items out of a larger set.
sc: I can count a given number of objects that are scattered and name the count.
I can count a given number of objects that are in a circle and name the count.
I can color a specific number of pictures from a group.
I can count pictures and write the number counted.

days.lo: I am learning to count 5-7 linking cubes in linear configurations
sc: I can count out a specific number of linking cubes using a 5-group mat and find a number card to match my count.
I can show a given number using my fingers the math way.
I can color a specific number of pictures from a group.

days.lo: I am learning to reason about sets of 7 varied objects in circular and scattered configurations and find a path through the scattered configuration.
sc: I can count a set of scattered objects and explain the path I used to count them.
I can write the number 7.
I can color a specific number of pictures from a group.
I can count pictures and write the number counted.

days.lo: I am learning to compare counts of 8 in linear and array configurations.
sc: I can count out a specific number of linking cubes using a 5-group mat and find a number card to match my count.
I can count pictures and circle the number that shows my count.
I can color a specific number of pictures.

days.lo: I am learning to arrange and strategize to count 8 beans in circular and scattered configurations.
sc: I can count a set of objects or pictures organized in a circle.
I can find a path to count a scattered set of objects or pictures.
I can compare my path to my partner’s path.
I can write the number 8.

days.lo: I am learning to organize and count 9 varied geometric objects in linear and array configurations.
sc: I can count out 9 geometric objects using a 5-group mat.
I can count 9 objects or pictures in a row.
I can count 9 objects or pictures in an array.
I can count a set of objects or pictures and choose the correct number card to match the count.

days.lo: I am learning to write 9 and strategize to count 9 objects in circular and scattered configurations.
sc: I can count a set of objects or pictures organized in a circle.
I can find a path to count a scattered set of objects or pictures.
I can number each object or picture.
I can write the number 9.

days.lo: I am learning to count 10 objects in linear and array configurations.
sc: I can count objects or pictures organized in a straight line (row) or in an array.
I can count a set of objects or pictures and choose the correct number card to match the count.
I can write the number 10.

days.lo: I am learning to count 10 objects, and move between all configurations.
sc: I can count 10 objects organized in different ways. (5-group mat, in a circle, long row, array, scattered.) Note: An individual SC can be created for each way above.
I can compare how I counted to how my partner counted.
I can draw, color, and count 10 pictures.

days.lo: I am learning to act out result unknown story problems without equations.
sc: I can act out a story problem using linking cubes.
I can listen to math stories and color pictures to show what is happening.
I can make up my own math story and use objects or draw pictures to go with it.

days.lo: I am learning to order and match numeral and dot cards from 1 to 10, and state one 1 more than a given number.
sc: I can place number cards in increasing order.
I can use dot cards to state 1 one more than a given number.
I can count dots and write how many.
I can draw 1 more picture, count, and write how many.

days.lo: I am learning to make math stairs from 1 to 10 in cooperative groups.
sc: I can make math stairs (towers) using linking cubes.
I can make math stairs by drawing pictures.
I can count steps the 1 more way.

days.lo: I am learning to arrange, analyze, and draw 1 more up to 10 in configurations other than towers.
sc: I can draw pictures around a circle (bracelet) to represent a given number of linking cubes.
I can draw 1 more picture in a circle set, count, and write how many.
I can draw 1 more picture in a scattered set, count, and write how many

days.lo: I am learning to arrange, analyze, and draw sequences of quantities of 1 more, beginning with numbers other than 1.
sc: I can name the number towers that are missing from a set of number stairs.
I can draw and write the number of the missing steps.
I can write the missing number and draw objects to show the number.

days.lo: I am learning to count and order quantities from 10 to 1, match numerals, and state one less than a given number.
sc: I can match a dot card to a given number or objects.
I can count down and order objects and a set of dot cards from 10 - 1.
I can count a set of dots and write the number counted.
I can count a set of pictures, cross 1 out, and write how many are left.
I can state the number that is 1 less than a given number.

days.lo: I am learning to arrange number towers in order from 10 to 1, and describe the pattern.
sc: I can put a set of linking cube stairs in decreasing order.
I can put the card with the correct number next to each stair.
I can count all the squares in a tower and write how many.
I can count stairs the 1 less way.
